commands.name: sm_module stat
commands.control_flow_proof: A03D72D6..A03D7644 switches on cached state at20DAA4B4, prints state text and, for transitional states, current module/connection metadata. Helpers A03D64D0/A03D6442 resolve names in existing arrays. All invoked helper paths only read metadata and format text.
commands.side_effects_assessment: UART formatting and stack temporaries only.
commands.output_limits: Small state-dependent diagnostic, typically one line after startup.

commands.name: sm_module task
commands.purpose: List module task IDs, priorities, stack sizes, entry points and task names for emulator comparison.
commands.control_flow_proof: A03D7646..A03D76CE loops over module count at20DAA488 and each descriptor task count at+8; 16-byte task descriptors at+4. A03D5994 scans603 fixed entries atA0607D54. Prints header atA03D78E8 and row format atA03D796C; delays10ticks every30 rows. No task is created or resumed.
commands.side_effects_assessment: UART formatting, bounded scheduling delays; if a task ID cannot be resolved, helper A03D5994 stores the unresolved ID at20DA5460 before returning fallback240.
commands.output_limits: Finite task-descriptor traversal. Header labels the fields; values are descriptors, not a live scheduler-state or CPU-utilization report.

commands.name: sm_module mem
commands.purpose: Read per-module initialization/task/start memory accounting and overall free-memory totals.
commands.control_flow_proof: A03D6670..A03D67A4 reads44-byte module records at20DAA480; fields+14/+18/+1C are accumulated into stack counters. A03D4512 calls A042BE56 for selectors0..3; that helper only returns cached free memory20DEC590 for selector2 and0 otherwise. No allocator is called.
commands.side_effects_assessment: UART formatting, stack totals and10tick delays every30rows.
commands.output_limits: Cached allocation accounting plus a current cached free-memory sample; not a destructive RAM test or physical installed-RAM measurement.

commands.name: sm_module tim
commands.purpose: Read per-module startup timing and phase timing totals.
commands.control_flow_proof: A03D6A6A..A03D6BA6, final formatter atA03D6E20, reads module fields+20/+24/+28 and cached phase counters. A03D20D0 is an ARM veneer toA0010578 for zeroing three local words. A03D67A6 maps phase IDs to constant text. No clock registers are accessed.
commands.side_effects_assessment: UART formatting, stack sums and10tick delays every30rows.
commands.output_limits: Historical boot/startup timing counters; units must follow returned labels and are not CPU-load measurements.

commands.name: sm_module mod
commands.purpose: List all registered modules, ranks, types and component IDs.
commands.control_flow_proof: A03D64E6..A03D666E reads44-byte module records and prints cached rank/type/CID/name. Descriptor context7 selects all three type bits. A03D64D0 resolves names. Reading method-pointer presence at object vtable+38 does not invoke that method.
commands.output_limits: Finite module list. Context7 is descriptor metadata passed by dispatcher, not a user argument.

commands.name: sm_module sysifc init
commands.purpose: List modules implementing system-interface slot init.
commands.control_flow_proof: A03D7B86 entry prints count, branches across literal data toA03D7D98, then traverses module records in reverse. Context1 selects vtable slot+0; A03D7DA2..A03D7EA2 only checks the method pointer for nonzero. A03D7EA4 calls name resolver and formatter; the inspected method is NEVER called. EndA03D7EC0.
commands.side_effects_assessment: UART formatting only; does not execute the named system operation.
commands.output_limits: Finite module names filtered by method-pointer presence. Header total is traversal population, not filtered match count.
